title: Chapter 247 Terrifying Firepower Output
content:
Chapter 247 Terrifying Firepower Output

"You Zerg are really unique! How did you achieve a one-star level leapfrogging several stars and directly upgrading to a five-star level?"

"Even if their original strength level was extremely high, it would be impossible to improve their strength so quickly just by relying on the luck beads!"

Naga witnessed the birth of a five-star Zerg destroyer and couldn't help but exclaimed.

"This is the magic of genetic evolution!"

Wu Qing explained it briefly through host No. 3 without saying much.

The high-level officials of the Naga army were also paying attention to the changes of the Zerg destroyers. When they found that the Zerg destroyers that absorbed the luck beads really upgraded their strength to five stars, they immediately sent people to convey the order to the two sub-battlefields to use the spare luck beads to enhance the strength of the Zerg destroyers.

The two sub-battlefields received the order and immediately followed it. Each sub-battlefield upgraded two thousand five-star Zerg destroyers.

This made Wu Qing earn a lot of Qi resources again.

With nine thousand five-star Zerg destroyers participating in the war, Wu Qing just had to wait for the war to start and harvest resources, and he didn't need to worry about anything else.

In order to better observe the battlefield situation and provide accurate battlefield information for the Zerg Destroyers, Wu Qing deliberately provided a lot of Zerg hosts when the Naga tribe asked him for them.

At this time, these Zerg hosts flew over the three battlefields, collecting information on the battlefield in all directions.

Wu Qing saw that there were many types of soldiers in the Skeleton Army, including various skeleton melee soldiers, magic soldiers, archers, cavalry, and flying soldiers.

There were also many strange siege weapons made of bones, emitting green light, which looked very creepy.

Among them, the skeleton cavalry riding on green flames, the flying skeleton birds, and the skeleton mages covered in black robes left a deep impression on Wu Qing.

As time passed, the armies of the Naga tribe and the Skeleton tribe were basically in place.

The Zerg Destroyers had already set up a loose formation in the core area of the Naga army, with a number of more than 300,000, occupying a large area of territory.

"No. 3, we will attack in advance, and you are the main force of the attack!"

"The siege weapons of both sides will open fire. Your deployment position is very far back, and ordinary siege weapons cannot hit you. We will try our best to ensure your safety!"

"The attack order has been issued. Don't worry about the attack target position. Just attack in full coverage!"

"If there is a special attack target, I will notify you in advance!"

"..."

The battle is about to begin, and Naga is explaining some precautions to host No. 3.

Wu Qing has seen through the Zerg host that the siege weapons of the Naga army and the Skeleton army are making final preparations and can launch an attack at any time.

The Naga tribe wants the Zerg destroyers to carry out a coverage attack because they cannot obtain and transmit the enemy's intelligence information in real time, and the specific combat command of the Zerg destroyers must also be carried out through host No. 3.

In the view of the Naga tribe, instead of issuing some unclear attack orders to the Zerg destroyers, it is better to let the Zerg destroyers carry out a full coverage attack, so that at least the powerful firepower of the Zerg destroyers will not be wasted.

As for how Host No. 3 commands the Zerg Destroyers to carry out a full-coverage attack, they have no control over it. As long as all the firepower is projected onto the enemy army, nothing else will be a problem. The Zerg Destroyers are allowed to play their own role.

310,000 Zerg Destroyers attack more than 5 million Skeleton Army. Wu Qing will definitely not let the Zerg Destroyers attack without focus.

Zerg Destroyers below five stars can carry out indiscriminate attacks on Skeleton Army according to the requirements of the Naga tribe. Since the Naga tribe has issued such an order, there must be a corresponding coordination plan.

As mercenaries, Zerg Destroyers must give priority to cooperating with their employers in combat.

As for the 5,000 five-star Zerg Destroyers, this is a temporary reinforcement. The Naga tribe only hopes that they can increase the power of the overall firepower output, and does not expect them to play a special role.

These reinforcements can just be used to carry out precise attacks according to Wu Qing's ideas.

Taking advantage of the Zerg's battlefield real-time intelligence advantage and Wu Qing's battlefield command, these 5,000 five-star Zerg destroyers are enough to influence the entire battle situation and greatly reduce the losses of the Naga army.

"Woo...!"

The horn of the Naga army's attack sounded.

The Naga siege weapons that had been prepared for a long time immediately launched an attack, and the Zerg destroyers who were waiting for this moment also opened fire instantly!

"Boom boom boom...!"

310,000 magma-like liquid fireballs were launched into the air at the same time, and the picture was very shocking!

It was also the first time that Wu Qing saw so many Zerg destroyers attacking at the same time, which cured his fear of insufficient firepower.

The Skeleton siege weapons that had been prepared for a long time were half a beat slower and also attacked the Naga army!

Both armies were very familiar with each other's attack methods, and they could respond calmly to the attacks of the enemy's siege weapons.

The attacks of these siege weapons looked very fierce, but in fact, as long as they were properly dealt with, they would not cause too many casualties.

Any soldier on this battlefield has star-level strength. With their own strength and excellent equipment, their defensive capabilities are not comparable to those of ordinary soldiers.

The two tribes have a large number of siege weapons, but they are all ordinary siege weapons. Neither side is a race like the goblins who are good at making things. Fighting on the battlefield mainly depends on the strength of the army itself.

This was the situation when the two tribes were in a long-term confrontation. Now that the Zerg Destroyers have joined the war, the situation has become completely different.

When more than 300,000 liquid fireballs were launched from the Naga army and flew towards the Skeleton army at high speed, the Skeletons found that the situation was not good.

At this time, there was no time to think about it. The troops of the Skeleton army that could attack the air immediately attacked the liquid fireballs flying at high speed.

However, there were too many liquid fireballs, evenly distributed over the huge Skeleton army phalanx, making it extremely difficult to intercept them from the air, and the success rate was very low.

The Zerg Destroyers also showed their true range for the first time. Under the reasonable distribution of the Queen, the liquid fireballs they launched almost covered the entire Skeleton army area.

The range of the Zerg Destroyers is beyond the reach of most siege weapons!

"With such a long range, there are indeed few troops that can do it!"

Before the Zerg Destroyers' attack fell, the Naga leaders recognized their performance.

"Boom boom!"

Countless explosions sounded in the Skeleton Army's square formation. The most violent explosions were in the area where the Skeleton Army's siege weapons were deployed!

This was the first wave of attacks commanded by Wu Qing with 5,000 five-star Zerg destroyers, which hit the Skeleton Army's siege weapons.

The terrible attack of 5,000 five-star Zerg destroyers accurately covered all the Skeleton Army's siege weapons.

Various bone parts and fragments flew everywhere, and the skeleton soldiers operating the siege weapons all turned into a ray of light and disappeared.

The Zerg destroyer's attack originally restrained the Skeleton Army, and with the five-star strength bonus, all the areas where the Skeleton Army deployed siege weapons became blank areas under the first round of Zerg destroyer attacks.

Only a field of skeleton parts was left, and no skeleton soldiers were seen.

Although some of the other Zerg destroyers had two-star, three-star and four-star strengths, most of them were one-star strengths.

The attack of the one-star Zerg Destroyer, which fell on the various arms of the Skeleton Army, was not powerful enough to kill the same-level enemies in one blow.

Except for some unlucky ones whose soul fire was damaged and died and turned into light, most of the Skeleton soldiers were only injured to varying degrees.

But the killing effect of the Zerg Destroyer was already perfect for the Naga!

In one round of attack, tens of thousands of enemies were eliminated and millions of enemies were injured. This was a killing efficiency that the Naga had never dared to think of before.

More importantly, the Zerg Destroyer seemed to concentrate its firepower and clean up the Skeleton's siege weapons at one time!

This was not only achieved by the strong attack power of the Zerg Destroyer, but also demonstrated the Zerg's powerful battlefield real-time intelligence collection and transmission capabilities, as well as a powerful command system and command capabilities.

This further enhanced the status of the Zerg in the hearts of the Naga leaders.

These Naga leaders were knowledgeable and could see the strength and potential of a race from some details.

From the performance of the Zerg, both in terms of strength and potential, they have the qualifications to compete for the status of a great clan.

The Naga clan now has a friendly relationship with the Zerg clan. In the absence of conflicts of interest, they certainly hope that the friendly clan can obtain the status of a great clan.

As a great clan, there are also differences in strength, and there are constant disputes among them. It is definitely a good thing to have one more friend.

The battlefield performance of the Zerg destroyer won the support of the Naga clan for the Zerg clan, which is also an important reason why Wu Qing helped the Naga clan with all his strength.

Among the great clans in the local camp, the Zerg clan has only come into contact with the Tengu clan, the Naga clan and the Goblin clan. The relationship between the Zerg clan and the Tengu clan is hard to describe, but they are definitely not friends.

Therefore, it is very important for the Zerg clan to obtain the real recognition and support of the Naga clan and the Goblin clan, which can help the Zerg clan avoid many detours in its development.

On the battlefield, the Skeleton clan army, which was attacked fiercely by the Zerg destroyer, was caught off guard.

The Naga clan's confidentiality measures were very well done, and the Skeleton clan's understanding of the Zerg destroyer was very limited.

The Zerg Destroyers only participated in the battle twice on a small scale, which had little impact and was not taken seriously by the Skeleton Tribe.

Now facing the ultra-long-range attack of such a large number of Zerg Destroyers, they were stunned all of a sudden.

This is a bit like two large tribes joining forces to fight the Skeleton Tribe.

After all, the Skeleton Tribe is a large tribe that can confront the Naga Tribe for a long time. The quality of the army is very high and the ability to respond to the battlefield is very strong. Those flying Skeleton Birds immediately took off and prepared to counterattack.
